This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Unexpected Games]]' [https://unexpectedgames.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{UnexpectedGames|subdomain=|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>https://unexpectedgames.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} If the URL is a subdomain of asmodee.com, the subdomain can be specified. 
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{UnexpectedGames|url=news/announcing-the-mandalorian-sworn-to-the-creed|text=Announcing The Mandalorian™: Sworn to the Creed}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{UnexpectedGames|url=news/announcing-the-mandalorian-sworn-to-the-creed|text=Announcing The Mandalorian™: Sworn to the Creed}}
